SELECT
    SALE_LINE_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS SALE_LINE_ID,
    CUSTOMER_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS CUSTOMER_ID,
    PRODUCT_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS PRODUCT_ID,
    CONTRACT_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS CONTRACT_ID,
    SUBMISSION_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS SUBMISSION_ID,
    'DIRECT'::VARCHAR AS SALE_TYPE,
    INV_DATE::DATE AS INV_DATE,
    INV_QTY::NUMBER(18,2) AS INV_QTY,
    INV_AMT::NUMBER(18,2) AS INV_AMT,
    DISC_REQUESTED::NUMBER(18,2) AS DISC_REQUESTED,
    DISC_PAID::NUMBER(18,2) AS DISC_PAID,
    LINE_SEVERITY::VARCHAR AS LINE_SEVERITY,
    DATE_CREATED::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
    DATE_UPDATED::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,
    DATE_UPDATED::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS DATE_UPDATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ETL_DATE_CREATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ETL_DATE_UPDATED,
    'sales'::VARCHAR AS SOURCE_SYSTEM
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW.DIRECT_SALE_LINES_RAW

SELECT
    p.PRODUCT_ID,
    p.PRODUCT_CODE,
    p.PRODUCT_NAME,
    p.PRODUCT_CATEGORY,
    p.PRODUCT_SUBCATEGORY,
    p.BRAND,
    p.MANUFACTURER,
    p.UNIT_PRICE,
    p.PRODUCT_STATUS,
    p.DATE_CREATED AS SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
    p.DATE_UPDATED AS SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE_CREATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE_UPDATED,
    'sales' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW.PRODUCT_RAW p


WHERE p.DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_product)
   OR p.DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_product)

SELECT
    c.CONTRACT_ID,
    c.CONTRACT_NUMBER,
    c.CONTRACT_NAME,
    c.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CONTRACT_TYPE,
    c.START_DATE,
    c.END_DATE,
    c.CONTRACT_VALUE,
    c.CONTRACT_STATUS,
    c.SALES_REGION,
    c.ACCOUNT_MANAGER,
    c.DATE_CREATED AS SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
    c.DATE_UPDATED AS SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE_CREATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE_UPDATED,
    'sales' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW.CONTRACT_RAW c


WHERE c.DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_contract)
   OR c.DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_contract)

SELECT
    c.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_NUMBER,
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    c.CUSTOMER_TYPE,
    c.INDUSTRY,
    c.ADDRESS,
    c.CITY,
    c.STATE,
    c.COUNTRY,
    c.EMAIL,
    c.PHONE,
    c.DATE_CREATED AS SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,

FROM SALES.SALES_RAW.CUSTOMER_RAW c


WHERE c.DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_customer)
   OR c.DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_customer)

SELECT
    SALE_LINE_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS SALE_LINE_ID,
    CUSTOMER_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS CUSTOMER_ID,
    PRODUCT_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS PRODUCT_ID,
    CONTRACT_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS CONTRACT_ID,
    SUBMISSION_ID::NUMBER(38,0) AS SUBMISSION_ID,
    'INDIRECT'::VARCHAR AS SALE_TYPE,
    INV_DATE::DATE AS INV_DATE,
    INV_QTY::NUMBER(18,2) AS INV_QTY,
    INV_AMT::NUMBER(18,2) AS INV_AMT,
    DISC_REQUESTED::NUMBER(18,2) AS DISC_REQUESTED,
    DISC_PAID::NUMBER(18,2) AS DISC_PAID,
    LINE_SEVERITY::VARCHAR AS LINE_SEVERITY,
    DATE_CREATED::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
    DATE_UPDATED::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,
    DATE_UPDATED::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS DATE_UPDATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ETL_DATE_CREATED,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ETL_DATE_UPDATED,
    'sales'::VARCHAR AS SOURCE_SYSTEM
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW.INDIRECT_SALE_LINES_RAW

WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.SALE_LINE_ID,
        s.CUSTOMER_ID,
        s.PRODUCT_ID,
        s.CONTRACT_ID,
        s.SUBMISSION_ID,
        s.SALE_TYPE,
        s.INV_DATE,
        s.INV_QTY,
        s.INV_AMT,
        s.DISC_REQUESTED,
        s.DISC_PAID,
        s.LINE_SEVERITY,
        s.INV_AMT AS GROSS_SALES,
        (s.INV_AMT - COALESCE(s.DISC_PAID, 0)) AS NET_AMOUNT,
        COALESCE(s.DISC_PAID, 0) AS DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,
        CASE WHEN s.INV_AMT = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COALESCE(s.DISC_PAID, 0) / s.INV_AMT) * 100 END AS DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.LINE_SEVERITY, '') = 'HIGH' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS LINE_SEVERITY_FLAG,
        s.SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
        s.SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,
        s.ETL_DATE_CREATED,
        s.ETL_DATE_UPDATED,
        s.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
        s.DATE_UPDATED
    FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_raw.stg_direct_sales s
)

SELECT
    SALE_LINE_ID,
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    PRODUCT_ID,
    CONTRACT_ID,
    SUBMISSION_ID,
    SALE_TYPE,
    INV_DATE,
    INV_QTY,
    INV_AMT,
    DISC_REQUESTED,
    DISC_PAID,
    LINE_SEVERITY,
    GROSS_SALES,
    NET_AMOUNT,
    DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,
    DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
    LINE_SEVERITY_FLAG,
    SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
    SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,
    ETL_DATE_CREATED,
    ETL_DATE_UPDATED,
    SOURCE_SYSTEM
FROM source_data


WHERE DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact_direct)
   OR SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact_direct)

WHERE DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact_indirect)
   OR SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED > (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED, DATE_UPDATED)) FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact_indirect)

SELECT
    SALE_LINE_ID,
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    PRODUCT_ID,
    CONTRACT_ID,
    SUBMISSION_ID,
    SALE_TYPE,
    INV_DATE,
    INV_QTY,
    INV_AMT,
    DISC_REQUESTED,
    DISC_PAID,
    LINE_SEVERITY,
    GROSS_SALES,
    NET_AMOUNT,
    DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,
    DISCOUNT_PERCENT,

    SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
    SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,

    ETL_DATE_UPDATED,
    SOURCE_SYSTEM
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact_direct

UNION ALL

SELECT
    SALE_LINE_ID,
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    PRODUCT_ID,
    CONTRACT_ID,
    SUBMISSION_ID,
    SALE_TYPE,
    INV_DATE,
    INV_QTY,
    INV_AMT,
    DISC_REQUESTED,
    DISC_PAID,
    LINE_SEVERITY,
    GROSS_SALES,
    NET_AMOUNT,
    DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,
    DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
    LINE_SEVERITY_FLAG,
    SRC_SYS_DATE_CREATED,
    SRC_SYS_DATE_UPDATED,
    ETL_DATE_CREATED,
    ETL_DATE_UPDATED,
    SOURCE_SYSTEM
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact_indirect

SELECT
    f.INV_DATE AS SALES_DATE,
    f.CUSTOMER_ID,
    f.PRODUCT_ID,
    f.CONTRACT_ID,
    f.SALE_TYPE,
    SUM(f.INV_QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY,
    SUM(f.GROSS_SALES) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SALES,
    SUM(f.NET_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_NET_AMOUNT,
    SUM(f.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_DISCOUNT,
    AVG(f.DISCOUNT_PERCENT) AS AVG_DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
    COUNT(*) AS SALES_COUNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.LINE_SEVERITY_FLAG = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HIGH_SEVERITY_LINES,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ETL_DATE_CREATED
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact f
GROUP BY
    f.INV_DATE,
    f.CUSTOMER_ID,
    f.PRODUCT_ID,
    f.CONTRACT_ID,
    f.SALE_TYPE

SELECT
    p.PRODUCT_ID,
    p.PRODUCT_NAME,
    p.PRODUCT_CATEGORY,
    p.BRAND,
    SUM(f.INV_QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY,
    SUM(f.GROSS_SALES) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SALES,
    SUM(f.NET_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_NET_AMOUNT,
    SUM(f.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_DISCOUNT,
    AVG(f.DISCOUNT_PERCENT) AS AVG_DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.SALE_LINE_ID) AS TOTAL_TRANSACTIONS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.LINE_SEVERITY_FLAG = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HIGH_SEVERITY_COUNT,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ETL_DATE_CREATED
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_product p
LEFT JOIN SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact f
    ON p.PRODUCT_ID = f.PRODUCT_ID
GROUP BY
    p.PRODUCT_ID,
    p.PRODUCT_NAME,
    p.PRODUCT_CATEGORY,
    p.BRAND

SELECT
    c.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    c.CUSTOMER_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.SALE_LINE_ID) AS TOTAL_ORDERS,
    SUM(f.INV_QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY,
    SUM(f.GROSS_SALES) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SALES,
    SUM(f.NET_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_NET_AMOUNT,
    SUM(f.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_DISCOUNT,
    AVG(f.DISCOUNT_PERCENT) AS AVG_DISCOUNT_PERCENT,
    MIN(f.INV_DATE) AS FIRST_PURCHASE_DATE,
    MAX(f.INV_DATE) AS LAST_PURCHASE_DATE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.LINE_SEVERITY_FLAG = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HIGH_SEVERITY_COUNT,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ETL_DATE_CREATED
FROM SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.dim_customer c
LEFT JOIN SALES.SALES_RAW_sales_canonical.sales_fact f
    ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = f.CUSTOMER_ID
GROUP BY
    c.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    c.CUSTOMER_TYPE
